From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@everwell.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 72-hour demo buffer while PO processes

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — our engineering and procurement teams are aligned and very interested in running a week-long eval, but procurement has flagged an internal process that will delay the official PO for ~5 business days. We don't want the sandbox or the trial to lapse mid-eval.

Can Redwood provide a short 72-hour demo buffer or a temporary token top-up so we can finish the proof-of-concept while finance completes the PO? We can share the PO draft immediately (attached) and I'll escalate on our side.

Attached: PO_draft_Everwell_0427.pdf (pdf, 180KB stub)

Appreciate any help — this is time-sensitive for our vendor evaluation window.

Best,
Elena Morales
Director, Clinical Integrations
Everwell Diagnostics
elena.morales@everwell.com
+1 (617) 555-0198

Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 72-hour demo buffer while PO processes

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and for sending the draft PO. I've looped in Ben (sales manager) and Grace (CS lead) so we can move quickly.

Short answer: we can grant a 72-hour demo buffer and provide a temporary 5,000-token credit to keep your eval environment live while procurement finishes the PO. To proceed we'll need:
- confirmation that the PO is in flight (your note is great)
- the expected PO ETA (date)

If you confirm, I'll record the allowance on the deal and Grace will open a support ticket to apply the credits. This will preserve your workspace and the KV cache for the next 72 hours.
